note.fr: Un diplôme étranger doit être jugé équivalent au havo, vwo ou mbo niveau 4 néerlandais. Vérifiez la procédure et les documents auprès du Studenten Service Center.
note.en: A foreign diploma must be assessed as equivalent to the Dutch havo, vwo or mbo level 4 diploma. Check the procedure and documents with the Studenten Service Center.

evidence.quote: Dan moet je aantonen dat dat gelijkwaardig is aan het vereiste Nederlandse havo-, vwo- of mbo-niveau 4-diploma.
Voor een Nederlandstalige hbo-opleiding moet je de Nederlandse taal op niveau B2 van het Europees Referentie Kader beheersen.

notes: Tuition: the programme page gives no non-EU fee, so the institution-wide instellingscollegegeld is used. The quoted amount sits in the row for 'Associate degrees, bachelor- en masteropleidingen (m.u.v. de onderstaande opleidingen)'; Accountancy full-time is not among the listed exceptions. The page does not literally say non-EU/EEA students pay it, only that the statutory fee requires conditions (nationality among them); the 2026-2027 amount EUR 10,684 is the one tied to full-time and part-time bachelor programmes. Intake: the page states a 1 May application deadline via Studielink but without a year, so it is recorded as recurring.
